# Ciago Technologies

> Premium technology services and consulting firm. We architect and build scalable software, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise platforms — from SaaS products to Kubernetes-powered SRE — for ambitious teams worldwide.

## Core offering

- Custom software & digital products: bespoke ERP and CRM systems, interactive admin dashboards, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, high-performance web interfaces, and cross-platform mobile applications.
- Core industry solutions: API-first e-commerce storefronts, smart back-office tools, high-throughput logistics data pipelines, and legacy system API modernization.
- Backend engineering & application security: concurrent high-throughput microservices, robust API architectures, proactive application security, encrypted data management.
- Cloud infrastructure & DevOps: highly available multi-region cloud design, cost optimization, CI/CD zero-downtime deployments, Kubernetes container orchestration, and proactive system monitoring / SRE.

## Target audience

Product teams, scale-ups, enterprises, retail and e-commerce brands, fintech companies, logistics and manufacturing operators, and internal platform teams looking for a senior engineering partner.
